title: How an agent's tool call reaches your screen
summary: Follow one `trace_to` call from Claude Code through CodeDiver's MCP server, the sandbox and the analysis index, until the graph appears in your window.

steps.title: The agent calls trace_to
steps.narration: You asked *how is Save triggered?* Claude Code sends a JSON-RPC `tools/call` to CodeDiver's local MCP endpoint on 127.0.0.1.

steps.title: Every tool goes through one wrapper
steps.narration: `addTool` times the call and records it in the activity feed, which is how you can always see what the agent looked at.

steps.title: Is this repo shared with agents?
steps.narration: `AgentRepo` enforces your switches: the global agent toggle and each repo's own setting. A hidden repo stops here with an error.

steps.title: The core service builds the trace
Answers come from the index
steps.narration: The index is rebuilt only when files change. Every read goes through the workspace sandbox, so `.env` files, keys and your excluded globs are invisible.

steps.title: show=true puts it on your screen
steps.narration: With **Follow agent** on, the focus event opens the trace in front of you while the agent is still writing its answer.

steps.title: The agent gets a text answer
steps.narration: Agents get compact text (cheaper than JSON); you get the interactive graph. Same data, two audiences.
